tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gdon sgrol gyi cho ga'i lag len shin tu gsal bar bshad pa'i yi ge phun tshogs bsam 'phel zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ shrī wan saṅgu ru badz+ra ā tsar+ya mahā dharmā swa mi ye na ma/ bod skad du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rdo rje slob dpon chen po chos kyi rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lung rtogs yon tan mtha' dag rang rgyud la/ /sbyor bar mdzad pa'i mtshan ldan bla ma dang / /rje btsun seng ge sgra la gus btud nas/ /gdon sgrol cho ga'i lag len ji snyed pa/ /blo gros mchog dman kun gyi go bde bar/ /shin tu gsal bar bstan pa'i legs bshad mchog /sngon med yi ge phun tshogs bsam 'phel 'di/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan phyir 'chad la spro/ /sa skya'i bla chen brgyud par bcas rnams dang / /snyigs dus bstan pa'i gsal byed sngags 'chang rje/ /yab sras rnams kyi rjes 'jug blo gsal tshogs/ /tshur byon thog mar lugs 'di'i chos tshul rnams/ /brgyud ldan bla ma'i drung du legs nos te/ /de rjes bsnyen pa las rung sngon 'gro bas/ /kho bos sbyar ba'i bstan bcos 'di bslab na/ /gdon sgrol cho ga'i lag len spyi bye brag /kun la 'jigs med blo yi gdeng thob 'gyur/ /de ltar mkhyen par mdzod la skal bzang rnams/ /sbyor ba gtsang sbra ldan zhing yo byad tshang / /dngos gzhi cho ga dag cing ting 'dzin gsal/ /kun kyang lhag bsam dag pas bstan 'gro la/ /phan par gyur cig snyam pa'i dag snang dang / /bcas pas cho ga'i phyag len 'khrul med 'di/ /nyams su blangs na rang dang yon bdag sogs/ /'gro kun bde ba'i rtsa bar 'gyur ro kye/ /zhes mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bca' ba dang / skal bzang rjes 'jug rnams la gdams pa'i tshig sngon du brjod nas/ 'dir gdon sgrol gyi cho ga lag len shin tu gsal bar bshad pa'i yi ge phun tshogs bsam 'phel zhes bya ba 'di 'chad pa la don gnyis te/ bsnyen pa dang las sbyor ro/

/dang po la 'di'i rjes gnang dang lung thob pa'i gang zag gis/ bum pa la brten pa ni gong ma'i gsung rab sogs las shes par bya'o/ /'dir bdag gi rnal 'byor la brten nas rab mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa dngos sam rmi lam du sku mthong ba sogs rtags ma byung gi bar dang / 'bring dus kyi bsnyen pa zla ba drug tha ma grangs kyi bsnyen pa 'bum phrag brgyad dam bzhi gtsang sbra dang ldan pas bya ba'o/ /gnyis pa las la sbyar ba la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po la lnga/ dkyil 'khor/ rten/ bum pa/ mchod pa/ gtor ma bsham pa'o/ /dang po la dkyil 'khor gang du bzhengs pa'i sa phyogs gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba dang / thebs zlog brtsis pa'i gza' skar bzang po 'dzoms pa'i nyin/ sa stegs khod snyoms pa la ba'i gci ba gtsang ma dang dri zhim po'i chus legs par byugs la/ slob dpon zhal nub tu phyogs pa'i mdun du/ byang nas rim pa ltar lha'i dkyil 'khor khru gang pa pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar/ seng sgra'i tshon spung dkar po/ rigs lnga'i mtshan ma gtso bo'i steng du dkar po/ shar sngon po/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang du ljang khu rnams tshon spung ngam/ yang na me tog gi tshom bu sogs gang rung bkod do/ /de'i g.yas phyogs su klu'i dkyil 'khor la/ thig gis bri ba dang / tshon gyis bri ba las/ thig la tshangs thig gdab pa nas/ /gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa/ /rtsig pa 'dod snam pha gu dang / /dra phyed shar bu mda' yab sogs/ /dkyil 'khor spyi dang mthun pa las/ /cung zad mi 'dra'i khyad par ni/ /sgo bzhi'i g.yas g.yon du/ tshangs pa'i thig nas cha chen re'i/ /rtags bya pha gu'i nang thig dang / /mda' yab nang thig gnyis po la/ /cha phran gnyis kyi rtags re bya/ /nang gi cha chen phyed du gdab/ /de'i phyi ma'ang phyed du gdab/ /phyi ma'i cha phran phyed du gdab/ /mun pa ka ba ka rgyan dang / /rta babs la sogs 'dir mi dgos/ /rtsig pa 'gro lugs spyi dang mthun/

/mda' yab rtsig steng tal mar 'gro/ /dbus nas zur bzhir reg par bskor/ /de yi phyi ru cha phran bskor/ /de nas dkyil 'khor nang thig ni/ /dbus kyi 'dab brgyad bzhag dang mtshungs/ /bsdu na klu la'ang 'dab brgyad te/ /gzhal yas khang pa mi dgos zhes/ /phyag len zor yang dbang du mdzad/ /de nas tshon gyis bri ba ni/ /dbus kyi 'dab brgyad dkar po'am/ /yang na sna tshogs mdog tu bya/ /phyogs mdog shar dkar lho ser po/ /nub dmar byang ljang rtsig pa ni/ /nang nas dmar sngo dkar rim gsum/ /gzhan rnams spyi dang 'dra ba las/ /'khyam rnams sngo skya chu ris kyis/ /mdzes par byas la de'i g.yas g.yon/ /phyogs kyi mdog can sbrul gnyis gnyis/ /phyogs bzhir brang sprod mtshams bzhi ru/ /mjug ma mdud cing lcags ri sngo/ /pad+ma'i lte ba 'dab brgyad la/ /klu chen so so'i kha dog dang / /mthun pa'i tshon phung sam nam dgu bkod/ /de'i g.yas phyogs su sa bdag gi dkyil 'khor pad+ma 'dab brgyad khru gang pa dkar po bris so/ /gnyis pa rten la gnyis las/ dang po mchod pa'i rten ni/ zhib zan nam/ bag zan la/ klu'i gzugs stod mi la sbrul mgo'i gdeng ka bdun bdun pa/ snying khar thal mo sbyar ba/ smad sbrul mjug 'khyil ba la rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan pa dgu byas te/ dbus kyi de che ba/ snod zangs gzhong gtsang ma la sogs pa'i nang du zan la pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi gzugs byas pa'i gdan gyi steng du bzhag pa/ klu'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su zangs kyi man+dzu'i steng du bzhag zangs kyi man+dzu ma 'byor na dkar gong sum 'dzoms kyi steng du bzhag go /gnyis pa gso ba'i rten ni/ yang zangs gzhong gi nang du sa bdag chen po zhes bya ba zan rtsa ba gru bzhi la/ dbus dang phyogs glang gi mgo bo lnga yod pa byas la/ de'i mtha' skor du klu phal ba rigs bzhi'i rten ni/ shar du sbrul/ lhor rus sbal/ nub tu 'jong mo/ byang du nya/

sa bdag phal pa'i rigs bzhi'i rten ni/ shar du sdig pa/ lhor sdom/ nub tu kha brgyad/ byang du grog mo/ gzhan yang bya khyung / rma bya/ gla ba/ 'ol pa/ phag rnams ma gtogs pa'i sems can sna tshogs pa'i gzugs brnyan phyogs re rer gnyis bya ba'am/ de tsam ma 'grub na re re byas te bkod/ de thams cad kyi mtha' ma sbrul brgyad kyi ra bas bskor ba/ sa bdag gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du zangs kyi man+dzu sogs kyi steng du bzhag go /gsum pa bum pa la gsum/ lha dang / dbang dang / rtsi sman gyi bum pa/ zangs sam rdza sogs la byas pa mgul 'ching dar bcas pa gsum bgegs bsal/ dang po gnyis su sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ tri lnga/ snying po lnga/ rin po che lnga ste bum rdzas nyer lnga gzhug gsum pa rtsi sman gyi bum par gzhi spang spos gtsang ma la byas la/ bzang drug dkar gsum mngar gsum dang / 'bras bu gsum dang rgya mtsho lbu/ /kon to ka ri chu srin sder/ /dbang po lag pa ge sar gsum/ /snye ma'i me tog ut+palasngon/ gra ma'i me tog zer ba'ang snang / /mtshal dkar spos shel rtsi dang ni/ /zho sha gsum dang rma bya'i mdongs/ /nor bu myu gu leb rgan dmar/ /lhang ma lhang 'tsher mkhal sran bre/ /phyag tshangs ku ba gser me tog /bṛ yang ku dang spang rgyan gnyis/ /sle tre gra ma mon bu dang / /dung dang rdo rgyus til dkar po/ /tsha ba gsum dang dug rigs dang / /gla rtsi dmar skyur drag po'i rdzas/ /spangs la ra dkar 'o ma'am/ /ser skya'i ba yi 'o ma dang / /dri bzang chu yis gsum gnyis dgang / /ku shas kha brgyan bum gdan bzhag /bzhi pa mchod pa la/ 'di rnams gang 'byor rtsi sman gyi bum par btab/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor so so'i mthar dbang ldan du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog dang / chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod tshan pa gsum bshams/ de tsam ma grub na spyi mthun du tshar gcig phyogs mtshams brgyad du bsham mo/

/gnyis pa ni dar ram/ ras sam/ shog bu dmar po la byas pa gdug dang / ba dan dang / ras skud dmar po khru gang pa dang bcas pa/ klu chen po dgu/ sa bdag phal pa rigs bzhi dang / klu phal pa rigs bzhi ste brgyad/ sha gnyer ba gnyis te tshan pa bcu dgu bsham/ de tsam ma 'byor na klu dgu la re re/ klu dang sa bdag phal pa gnyis la re re/ sha gnyer ba rnams la re re ste tshan pa bcu gsum so so'i thad kar zan la 'dzugs/ gzugs la btsugs na klu dang sa bdag sogs gnod par 'gyur bas 'dzugs mi nyan no/ /lnga pa gtor ma ni/ lha'i gtor ma/ klu'i gtor ma/ sa bdag gi gtor ma rnams zlum gtor pad 'dab can re re so so'i shar du bsham/ dkyil 'khor rnams kyi g.yas phyogs su/ lho nub nas shar lho'i bar la phyogs skyong dang / 'byung po dang / bgegs gtor rnams mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bshams la/ de rnams dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs kyi kha zas 'byor pa sogs kyang bzhag cing / dmar skyur ma 'dres pa gtsang sbra dang ldan pa bya zhing / gzhan yang slob dpon gyi mdun du stegs kyi steng du rdo rje dril bu 'thor nas/ bum pa gsum/ gzungs rdor/ dung chos/ gos zung / rma bya'i sgro lnga dang / gzhan yang bsgrub byar dgos pa'i yo byad rol mo sogs sta gon bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la lnga ste/ bdag bskyed/ lha bum/ klu/ gdon/ bsgrub bya la ji ltar bya ba'o/ /dang po la bdag lhar bskyed pa/ bzlas pa bya ba/ mchod pa/ bstod pa bya ba dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ rang nyid khrus byas gos gsar ba gyon/ stan bde ba la 'dug cing / zhal dkyil 'khor la mngon par phyogs te/ thog mar mchod rdzas rnams/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3ham̐/ gis sbyangs/ 'og tu bsang sbyangs zhes pa'i skabs su 'di ltar dran par bya'o/ /stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon zhabs bsil/

me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ ces dang / so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+gham̐ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yam̐ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra a lo ke swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ne wi te swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ sam̐ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsā li ni/ pra dzñā pa ra mi tā nā da swa bhā we na/ badz+ra dharma hri da ya/ san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a kham̐ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum rol mo dang bcas pas byin dbab cing / 'og tu mchod pa byin rlabs dgos pa rnams la dharmā ra ṇi mi brjod pa khyad par ro/ /bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan rnams la༞ dam pa'i chos rnams la༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la༞ zhes pa lan nyer gcig la sogs pa ci nus byas la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun seng ge sgra'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes pa lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ rang skad cig gis 'phags pa seng ge sgrar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hriḥdakar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i 'phags pa seng ge sgra la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas spyan drangs/

na mo gu ru bh+yaḥn mo ā hrīḥ singha nā da sa pa ri wa ra bh+yaḥzhes pas phyag bya/ oṃ ā hrīḥsingha nā da sa pa ri wā ra ar+gham̐/ pā d+yam̐/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pam̐/ dī pam̐/ gan+dham̐/ nai wi d+yam̐/ shap+ta pra tits+tsha ye swāhā/ zhes pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yid rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ongs spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /sogs lan gsum gyi rgyun bshags dang / sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom la/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3ham̐/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar seṃ las seng ge dkar mo mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hrīḥdakar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib/ klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad bcom/ 'phags pa seng ge sgra'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrīḥyig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa seng ge sgra sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon pad+ma dkar po'i yu ba bzung nas dku g.yon gyi phyogs su gdan la brten cing snyan gyi thad sor kha phye ba'i steng na ral gri me 'bar ba dang /

thod pa dkar po me tog dang 'bru bcud sman sna rtsi sogs kyis gang ba 'dzin pa/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan zhing / ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing / dbu'i gtsug tor dang bcas pa/ sku g.yas phyogs su cung zad ma reg pa'i tri shu la ljang khu'i yu bar sbrul dkar sngon gnyis mgo gyen du bstan nas dkris pa/ kṛṣ+ṇa sa ra'i lpags pas nu ma g.yon bkab cing / dar dmar po'i sham thabs dang tshangs skud ma gtogs pa'i rgyan gzhan thams cad spangs pa/ dka' thub kyi cha lugs can/ zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥhrīḥsingha na da sa pa ri wā ra oṃ ar+gham̐/ pā d+yaṃ/ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs kha'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ.oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+gham̐/ sogs gong bzhin mchod/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu mam̐ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan/ rang gi spyi bo nas rnam par snang mdzad/ dpung pa g.yas nas mi bskyod pa/ g.yon nas 'od dpag med/ sku sta zur g.yas nas rin chen 'byung ldan/ g.yon nas don yod grub pa rnams 'phros nas gnas de dang de nyid du bzhugs par gyur/ gnyis pa ni/ rang nyid lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa'i thugs kha'i hriḥyig gi mtha' mar sngags 'phreng kha dog dkar pos bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sbyangs/ khyad par klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad byin gyis brlab par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la ngag tu/

oṃ āḥhriḥsingha nā da hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces ci mang dang / thun zhabs su/ gzungs ring 'di bzla ste/ na mo rat+na tra ya ya/ na mo ar+ya ā wa lo ki te re shwa ra ya/ bo dhi satwa ya/ mahā swa twa ya/ mahā ka ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ā ka ṭe bi ka ṭe/ ni ka ṭe/ ka ṭam̐ ka ṭe/ ka ro ṭe/ ka ro ṭa/ bīr+ya ye swāhā/ zhes pa ji ltar dmigs pa bzlas mthar bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun du byon par bsam la/ gsum pa ni/ oṃ āḥhriḥsingha nā da sa pa ri wā ra ar+gham̐/ pā d+yam̐/ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas bzhi pa ni rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ brtse ba'i thugs rje dbang phyug nyid kyi sku/ /drang srong chen po'i tshul du bstan nas kyang / /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal drag po sel mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi gnas skabs kyi 'gal rkyen/ klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa/ nad gdon sdug bsngal thams cad zhi ba dang / mthar thug seng ge sgra'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab pa ste bdag bskyed do/ /gnyis pa lha'i bya ba la gnyis/ mdun bskyed bsgrub pa dang mchod pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi/ mdun bskyed kyi lha bskyed pa/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa/ ye shes kyi tshogs 'khor dgug gzhug bya ba/ dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab pa'o/ /dang po ni bris sku'am dkyil 'khor la dmigs te bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar seng ge dkar po mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hrīḥdakar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad bcom/ 'phags pa seng ge sgra'i go 'phang la bkod/

tshur 'dus hriḥyig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las 'phags pa seng ge sgra sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon pad+ma dkar po'i yu ba bzung nas dku g.yon gyi phyogs su gdan la brten cing / snyan gyi thad sor kha bye ba'i steng na ral gri me 'bar ba dang / thod pa dkar po me tog dang 'bru bcud sman rtsi sna tshogs kyis gang ba 'dzin/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan zhing / ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing dbu gtsug tor dang bcas pa/ sku g.yas su cung zad ma reg pa'i tri shu la ljang khu'i yu bar sbrul dkar sngon gnyis mgo gyen du bstan nas dkris pa/ kṛṣ+ṇa sa ra'i lpags pas nu ma g.yon bkab cing / dar dmar po'i sham thabs dang / tshangs skud ma gtogs pa'i rgyan gzhan thams cad spangs pa/ dka' thub kyi cha lugs can/ zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i steng du oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ 'dab ma brgyad kyi shar du hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ lhor tram̐ las rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ nub tu hriḥlas 'od dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ byang du a las don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing / dar gyi na bza' can/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rje btsun seng ge sgra rigs lnga'i tshogs pa can la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

spos dang bcas pas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi zad 'dzoms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru/ /'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyangs shing / /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing / /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /yongs dag 'khor dang bcas rnams gshegs su gsol/ /chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing / /nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che/ /dad pas spyan ni drang bar bgyi/ /zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa/ /dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs/ /chos dang ye shes chags bral ba/ /kun tu mi zad nus par ldan/ /tshur spyon tshur spyon gzhi bdag lha/ /thub pa'i skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen/ /shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan gyi/ /mchod pas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /'dir ni gzugs dang lhan gcig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang / /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ /zhes dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta singha na da sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ zhes pas mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod/ /bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /sogs mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta ga ga na sa ma ya hūm̐ swāhā/

mchod yon phul/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /khrus gsol ba'i steng ka byed cing / oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes pas khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs rje'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /pad+ma'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ya staṃ/ zhes pas gdan phul la/ oṃ āḥhriḥsingha na da sa pa ri wa ra ar+gham̐/ nas/ shap+ta'i bar phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod la/ gsum pa ni/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ bzhi pa ni/ slar yang thugs kha'i hriḥlas 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra argaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyi mchod la/ oṃ a bhī ṣiñtsa tu mam̐ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rje btsun seng ge sgra la 'od dpag med dang / rigs gzhan rnams la rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan/ gnyis pa mchod pa la lnga/ nyer spyod/ rin chen sna bdun/ 'dod yon rnam lnga/ gtor ma btang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ ces dang / so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa/ oṃ badz+ra ar+gham̐ swāhā/ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ thal mo sbyar te/

mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla bre dang / /mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkyes shing / /mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bsgrengs byas nas/ /bdag nyid chen po dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta singha na da sa pa ri wā ra ar+gham̐ pra tits+tsha pu dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ zhabs bsil༞ zhabs bsil༞ zhabs bsil༞ bdag nyid༞ oṃ sarba sogs nas/ pād+yam̐/ sogs 'don pa bsgyur la/ me tog༞ me tog༞ me tog༞ bdag nyid༞ puṣ+pe༞ bdug spos༞ bdug spos༞ bdug spos༞ bdag nyid༞ dhu pam̐༞ snang gsal༞ snang gsal༞ snang gsal༞ bdag nyid༞ a lo ke༞ dri mchog༞ dri mchog༞ dri mchog༞ bdag nyid༞ gan+dhe༞ zhal zas༞ zhal zas༞ zhal zas༞ bdag nyid༞ nai wi te༞ rol mo༞ rol mo༞ rol mo༞ bdag nyid༞ shap+ta༞ dharmā ra ṇi tas rol mo sogs dbul/ gnyis pa ni/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba bita pu ra pu ra pu ra a brta ya a brta ya hoḥzhes brjod cing thal mo snying khar sbyar la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta singha na da sa pa ri wā ra tsakra rat+na pu dzi te hūm̐/ zhes so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la/ /nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas/ /bkren zhing phongs pa rgyun bcad de/ /'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /gong bzhin thog mtha' 'dra ba las so/ /tsakra'i gnas su/ ma ṇi rat+na/ sogs sbyar la/ btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de/ /shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /wasti rat+na/ blon po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan/ /bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing / /yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /mahā rat+na/ rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas/

/srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol te/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas/ /sangs rgyas zhing du 'gro bar shog /tu raṅga a shwa rat+na/ dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas/ /nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas/ /phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de/ /snyem bral mchog ni thob par shog /khataṣa rat+na/ ces dang / gsum pa ni/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ongs rgyan 'phreng ldan/ /phyogs dus kun nas gzugs mchog ci mchis pa/ /mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul gyis/ /bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta singha na da sa pa ri wā ra rū pa kā ma gu na pū dzi te hūm̐/ de bzhin du so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i/ /yon tan tshim mchog sgra snyan ci mchis rnams/ /mos blos༞ bzhes shig༞ gong bzhin thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ rū pa'i gnas su/ shap+ta sogs sbyar la/ phyogs dus kun nas tsan+dan sbrul snying dang / /a kar nag sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams/ /mos blos༞ bzhes shig༞ gan+dhe༞ phyogs dus kun nas ro dang bcud ldan pa'i/ /lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis pa/ /mos blos༞ bzhes shig༞ ra sa༞ phyogs dus kun nas 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i/ /reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed rnams/ /mos blos༞ bzhes shig༞ par+ṣe/ zhes pas gos zung phul/ bzhi pa ni/ 'khor ba 'dzin rgyu chags bral zhing / /'gro ba'i don la chags pa yi/ /pad+ma dmar po'i gdan la bzhugs/ /seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs dang bag tsha mi mnga' ba/ /kun tu thogs med stobs brnyes pas/ /seng ge dkar po'i khri la bzhugs/ /seng ge sgra la༞ thabs dang snying rje'i ngo bo nyid/ /yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs pa/ /zla ba rgyas pa'i gdan dang ldan/ /seng ge sgra la༞ nyon mongs pa dang shes bya yi/ /dri ma gnyis spangs sku mdog dkar/ /'od zer dpag med phyogs bcur spro/ /seng ge sgra la༞

dbu la ral ba'i thor gtsug can/ /'od dpag med pas rab tu mdzes/ /tshogs gnyis ma lus rdzogs pa po/ /seng ge sgra la༞ spyan gsum thugs rje chen po yis/ /khams gsum dus gsum gzigs pa po/ /phyag gnyis thabs dang shes rab nyid/ /seng ge sgra la༞ phyi rol pa rnams 'dul ba'i phyir/ /rgyan spangs mchod phyir thogs pa 'dzin/ /gangs ri ltar dkar drang srong tshul/ /seng ge sgra la༞ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la/ /mnga' brnyes rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis/ /sems can don bzhugs phyed krung mdzad/ /seng ge sgra la༞ zag bcas nyes skyon ma gos pas/ /pad+ma las skyes pad+ma 'dzin/ /pad+ma'i rigs mchog pad+ma bsnams/ /seng ge sgra la༞ 'gro ba'i gnod pa sel mdzad pa/ /dri med me tog gis bkang ba'i/ /thod pa dkar po g.yon na 'dzin/ /seng ge sgra la༞ shes rab ral gri ye shes 'bar/ /ma rig mun pa thams cad 'joms/ /gti mug la sogs rtsad nas gcod/ /seng ge sgra la༞ tri shu la ni g.yas na 'dzin/ /sna tshogs don mdzad ljang khu ste/ /khams gsum nyes pas mi gos phyir/ /rtse gsum 'dzin la༞ gdug pa can rnams rab 'dul zhing / /chu bdag dam las mi 'da'i phyir/ /brang 'gro dkar pos rab tu brgyan/ /klu rnams 'dul la༞ ye shes chen po'i rang bzhin can/ /dbang bskur ba ni rab stsol zhing / /sku gsum byin rlabs thugs rje can/ /seng ge sgra la༞ spros pa'i mtha' brgyad las grol zhing / /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rnam par mdzes/ /sprul pa'i rigs lngas dbu la brgyan/ /sku gsum lhun grub khyod phyag 'tshal/ /shin tu dang ba'i yid kyis ni/ /tshig gi phreng bas khyod bstod pas/ /bdag sogs 'gro ba ma lus kun/ /khyed kyi go 'phang mchog thob shog /ces pas gtso bo la bstod/ rigs lnga la/ snang stong rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings/ /chos dbyings ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal rnam par snang mdzad la/

/gzung 'dzin rdo rje bstan pa'i sa/ /me long ye shes༞ bdud 'dul chen po'i༞ phyag 'tshal mi bskyod rdo rje la/ /rin chen rdo rje 'bar ba'i me/ /mnyam nyid ye shes༞ mchog sbyin chen po'i༞ phyag 'tshal rin chen 'byung ldan la/ /'dod chags rdo rje chos kyi chu/ /kun rtog ye shes༞ ting 'dzin chen po'i༞ phyag 'tshal snang ba mtha' yas la/ /phrag dog rdo rje bskyod pa'i rlung / /bya grub ye shes༞ skyabs sbyin chen po'i༞ phyag 'tshal don yod grub pa la'o/ /zhes pas bstod do/ /yang mchod bstod bsdus pa byed par spro na/ mchod pa rnams kyi tshig bcad rnams dor la sngags tsam gyis mchod cing / bstod pa ni gtso bo la/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyan ras kyis/ /sems can kun la gzigs mdzad pa/ /stobs dang mi 'jigs mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces dang / rigs lnga la/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang / /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod/ de nas mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i seng ge sgra'i snying po brgya rtsa bzlas la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi gnas skabs kyi 'gal rkyen klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa/ nad gdon sdug bsngal thams cad zhi ba dang / mthar thug seng ge sgra'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces brjod/ lnga pa gtor ma btang ba la gnyis/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma 'bul ba dang / 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma btang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gtor ma rnams chu gtsang mas sbyangs la/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/

nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ āḥhriḥsangha na da sa pa ri wā ra/ oṃ a ka ro mu kham̐ sarba dharmā ṇam̐ ad+ya nur+pan na twad/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes pa gsum mam lngas phul la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta singha na da sa pa ri wā ra ar+gham̐/ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyan ras kyis/ /sems can kun la gzigs mdzad pa/ /stobs dang mi 'jigs mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi gnas skabs kyi 'gal rkyen klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa/ nad gdon sdug bsngal thams cad zhi ba dang / mthar thug seng ge sgra'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pas gsol ba btab/ gnyis pa ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i cha gsum gyi cho gas btang / gsum pa bum pa bskyed pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ lha'i bum pa'i steng du dung chos rdor gzungs dang bcas pa bsham nas/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du bh+rum̐ las rin po che'i bum pa gsum yangs shing rgya che ba zhabs zhum pa lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs dang / rtsi sman gyi bum par klu dang sa bdag gi nad zhi bar byed pa'i sman sna tshogs kyi gang ba/ lha'i bum pa'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ sing las seṅge dkar po mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su hrīḥdakar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib/ klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad bcom/ 'phags pa seng ge sgra'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrīḥyig la thim/

de yongs su gyur pa las/ 'phags pa seng ge sgra sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon pad+ma dkar po'i yu ba bzung nas sku g.yon gyi phyogs su gdan la bsten cing / snyan gyi thad sor kha phye ba'i steng na ral gri me 'bar ba dang / thod pa dkar po me tog dang 'bru bcud sman rtsi sna tshogs kyis gang ba 'dzin pa/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan zhing ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing / dbu gtsug tor dang bcas pa/ sku g.yas phyogs su cung zad ma reg pa'i tri shu la ljang khu'i yu ba sbrul dkar sngon gnyis mgo bo gyen du bstan nas dkris pa/ kṛṣ+ṇa sa ri'i lpags pas nu ma g.yon bkab cing / dar dmar po'i sham thabs dang / tshangs skud ma gtogs pa rgyan gzhan thams cad spangs pa/ dka' thub kyi cha lugs can zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun du nam las chu bdag wa ru ṇa dkar po bka' nod pa'i tshul du gnas pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la nam brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du mtha' yas sngon po/ lhor nor rgyas ser po/ nub tu 'jog pa dmar po/ byang du stobs rgyu ljang khu/ mer pad+ma dmar po/ srin por pad+ma chen po sngon po/ rlung du dung skyong ser po/ dbang ldan du rigs ldan dkar po ste thams cad kyang sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun bdun dang ldan pa'i spyi bor yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal pos mdzes shing / dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ smad sbrul mjug 'khyil ba/ stod lha'i gzugs can snying khar thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /de rnams kyi mtha' skor du skad cig gis shar du brgya byin/ lhor gshin rje/ nub tu chu lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ shar lhor me lha/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du rlung lha/ byang shar du dbang ldan/ steng du tshangs pa/ 'og tu sa lha/ thams cad kyang rang rang gi sku mdog dang /

rgyan cha lugs so so'i g.yog dang bcas par gyur/ lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs kha'i nang du zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa seng ge sgra'i lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥrdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi zad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru/ /'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje rnam sbyangs shing / /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing / /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /yongs dag 'khor dang bcas rnams gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta singha na da sa pa ri wa ra e h+ye hi/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ āḥhrīḥsingha na da sa pa ri wā ra oṃ ar+gham̐/ pā dam̐/ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+gham̐/ sogs gong bzhin mchod/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu mam̐ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ri bha wā a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las seng ge sgra klu chen dgu dang bcas pa la 'od dpag med/ phyogs skyong bcu la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta singha na da sa pa ri wā ra/ re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i/ ar+gham̐ nas/

shap+ta/ dharmā ra ṇi rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ brtse ba'i thugs rje dbang phyug nyid kyi sku/ /drang srong chen po'i tshul du bzhugs nas kyang / /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal drag po sel mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas seng ge sgra dang / gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni/ /sa 'og mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa/ /bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas klu chen dgu dang / tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs pa/ /chos kyi dbyings las dbyer med kyang / /rnam 'phrul du mas bstan pa skyong / /phyogs skyong bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas phyogs skyong bcu la bstod pa'o/ /de nas gzungs thag blangs te/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten nas song bas bum nang gi lha'i rgyud bskul nas/ thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ ces brjod la/ oṃ āḥhriḥsingha na da hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pa brgya rtsa dang / na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ar+ya a wa lo ki te shwa ra ya/ bo dhi sa twa ya/ mahā sa twa ya/ mahā ka ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a ka ṭe/ bi ka ṭe/ ni ka ṭe/ ka ṭam̐ ka ṭe/ ka ro ṭa/ bīr+ya ye swāhā/ zhes pa ji ltar rigs pa bzlas la/ de nas klu'i rgyal po dgu'i sngags ni/ oṃ phu wa ru ra ye/ nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ phuḥ.ā nan+da ye nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ phuḥb su ka ye nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ phuḥrak+ṣa ka ye nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ phuḥkar ko ṭa ye nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ phuḥpad+ma ye nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ phuḥmā hā pad+ma ye nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ phuḥsham̐ kha pā la ye nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ phuḥku li ka ye nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/

zhes pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa la/ de nas phyogs skyong bcu'i sngags bzlas te/ oṃ sha kra ye swāhā/ ta k+ṣa ye/ ag+ne ye/ ya ma ye/ ni ri ti ye/ ba ru ṇa ye/ ba ra bi ri/ ku bā+e ra ye/ ru tra ye/ ur+dham̐ bra ha ma na ye/ sur+ya bra na/ a dhi pa ta ye/ tsaṇ+ḍa nak+ṣa a dhi pa ta ye/ a dhi pri thi wi bh+yaḥ a su ra bh+yaḥ na ge bh+yaḥswāhā/ zhes pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ gnyis pa dbang gi bum pa la rdo rjer gzungs spos la/ rang gi snying kha nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten nas song bas bum pa'i chu nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhriḥsingha na da hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces dang / yum gyi sngags ni/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dha lo tsā ne sarba ar+thā pā dha na ye swāhā/ zhes de bzhin gshegs pa rigs bzhi'i yum dang / oṃ pra bha wa dh+ya bhu pra bha wa dh+ya bhurbu wa swa pra bha wa dh+ya/ pra wa dh+ya/ sarba na ga duḥ kho pra sha ma na ye swāhā/ zhes klu'i rigs kyi yum ste/ yum gnyis kyi sngags nyer gcig bzlas/ yang / oṃ phuḥwa ru ṇa ya ེbhu mi pa ti phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ phuḥ.a nan+da ye bhu mi pa ti phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ phuḥb su ka ye bhu mi pa ti phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ phuḥtak+ṣa ka ye bhu mi pa ti phuḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ phuḥkarko ṭa ye bhu mi pa ti phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ phuḥpad+ma ye bhu mi pa ti phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ phuḥmahā pad+ma ye bhu mi pa ti phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ phuḥsham̐ kha pā la ye bhu mi pa ti phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ phuḥku li ka ye bhu mi pa ti phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes pa nyer gcig bzlas so/ /gsum pa yang gzungs thag rtsi sman gyi bum par spos la/ bdud rtsir bsgyur ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ di bya a mṛ te/ sa man+tar+pa sha mi ta/ pra trits+tsha/ tha pa sa nan na ma swāhā/ zhes nyer gcig bzlas pas bdud rtsir bsgyur bar bsam la/ lha'i bum pa la sngar bzhin/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta singha na da sa pa ri wā ra/ re re mgor sbyar ba'i/ ar+gham̐ nas/ shap+ta/ dharma ra ṇi rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ brtse ba'i thugs rje dbang phyug nyid kyi sku/ /drang srong chen po'i tshul du bzhugs nas kyang / /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal drag po sel mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni/ /sa 'og mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa/ /bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs pa/ /chos kyi dbyings las dbyer med kyang / /rnam 'phrul du mas bstan pa skyong / /phyogs skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod nas/ dung chos kyi mchod yon bum par blug la/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ par bsam la yig brgya lan gsum gyis brtan par bsam mo/ /yang bum bskyed bdag bskyed kyi mjug tu mdzad pa'i phyag len yang yod pas gang bde bya'o/ /bzhi pa klu dang 'brel ba'i cho ga la drug klu bskyed pa/ spyan drangs pa/ dgug gzhug bya ba/ dbang bskur ba/ mchod pa 'bul ba/ stod pa bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ klu'i gzugs dang dkyil 'khor bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bh+rum̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin dmar sngo dkar ba'i rtsig pa gsum dang ldan pa'i steng du/ rin po che'i pha gu ser po la dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ mda' yab dang pu shus mdzes par byas pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la gnas pa'i lha mo sna tshogs pas mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas 'khod pa/ de'i phyi rol sgo bzhi'i thad sor/

shar du sbrul dkar po gnyis/ lhor sbrul ser po gnyis/ nub tu sbrul dmar po gnyis/ byang du sbrul ljang khu gnyis rnams brang sprad cing / mtshams bzhir mjug ma mdud pa/ de'i phyi rol lcags ri sngon pos bskor ba/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/ nang gi phyogs mdog shar dkar/ lhor ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams kyi steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ nam dgu las 'od zer 'phros/ 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ dbus su chu bdag wa ru ṇa dkar po/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du mtha' yas sngon po/ lhor nor rgyas ser po/ nub tu 'jog po dmar po/ byang du stobs rgyu ljang khu/ mer pad+ma dmar po/ srin por pad+ma chen po sngon po/ rlung du dung skyong ser po/ dbang ldan du rigs ldan dkar po/ thams cad kyang sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun bdun dang ldan pa'i spyi bor yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal pos mdzes shing / dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ smad sbrul mjug 'khyil ba/ stod lha'i gzugs can snying khar thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ gnyis pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rgya mtsho chen po'i klong dkyil nas klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa la klu dang sa bdag dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni/ /sa 'og mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'dzoms mdzad cing / /bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /klu rgyal 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /zhes dang mthe bong gshibs pa'i rgyab tu mdzub mo gnyis rtse sprad/ sor mo lhag ma rnams brkyangs pa gdengs ka'i tshul du byas la/

mthe bos nang g.yab cing / oṃ e h+ye hi na ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ye swāhā/ zhes dang / oṃ swa wi ti/ pra wi te/ a gats+tsha swāhā/ lan gsum gyis spyir dgug de nas/ oṃ wa ru ṇa ye e h+ye hi/ a nan+da ye/ ba su ka ye/ rak+ṣa ka༞ karko ṭa ye༞ pad+ma༞ mahā pad+ma ye༞ sham̐ kha pā la ye༞ ku li ka ye༞ mgor oṃ dang mthar e h+ye hi zhes pa kun la sbyar te spyan drangs so/ /gsum pa ni/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas gnyis su med par bstim/ bzhi pa ni/ slar yang thugs ka'i hriḥlas 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+gham̐/ sogs nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu mam̐ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med pa re res dbu brgyan/ zhes bsam zhing / lnga pa ni/ mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ ces dang / so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+gham̐/ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ wa ru ṇa ye gṛh+ṇe dam̐ ar+gham̐ swāhā/ de bzhin du/ oṃ a nan+da gṛh+ṇe dam̐༞ oṃ ba su ka ye༞ oṃ tak+ṣa ka ye༞ oṃ karko ṭa ye༞ oṃ pad+ma ye༞ oṃ mahā pad+ma ye༞ oṃ sham̐ kha pā la ye༞ oṃ ku li ka ye gṛh+ṇa dam̐ ar+gham̐ swāhās/ mchod yon dang / yang / oṃ wa ru ṇa ye gṛh+ṇa dam̐ pā d+yam̐ swāhā/ de bzhin du/ oṃ a nan+da༞ oṃ ba su ka ye༞ oṃ tak+ṣa ka ye༞ oṃ karko ṭa ye༞

oṃ pad+ma ye༞ oṃ mahā pad+ma ye༞ oṃ sham̐ kha pā la ye༞ oṃ ku li ka ye༞ oṃ wa ru ṇa ye gṛh+ṇa dam̐ puṣ+pam̐ swāhā/ de bzhin du/ oṃ a nan+da༞ oṃ ba su ka ye༞ oṃ tak+ṣa ka ye༞ oṃ karko ṭa ye༞ oṃ pad+ma ye༞ oṃ mahā pad+ma ye༞ oṃ sham̐ kha pā la ye༞ oṃ ku li ka ye༞ oṃ wa ru ṇa ye gṛh+ṇa dam̐ dhu pam̐ swāhā/ de bzhin du/ oṃ a nan+da༞ oṃ ba su ka ye༞ oṃ tak+ṣa ka ye༞ oṃ karko ṭa ye༞ oṃ pad+ma ye༞ oṃ mahā pad+ma ye༞ oṃ sham̐ kha pā la ye༞ oṃ ku li ka ye༞ oṃ wa ru ṇa ye gṛh+ṇa dam̐ a lo ke swāhā/ de bzhin du/ oṃ a nan+da༞ oṃ ba su ka ye༞ oṃ tak+ṣa ka ye༞ oṃ karko ṭa ye༞ oṃ pad+ma ye༞ oṃ mahā pad+ma ye༞ oṃ sham̐ kha pā la ye༞ oṃ ku li ka ye༞ oṃ lwa ru ṇa ye gṛh+ṇa dam̐ gan+dham̐ swāhā/ de bzhin du/ oṃ a nan+da༞ oṃ ba su ka ye༞ oṃ tak+ṣa ka ye༞ oṃ karko ṭa ye༞ oṃ pad+ma ye༞ oṃ mahā pad+ma ye༞ oṃ sham̐ kha pā la ye༞ oṃ ku li ka ye༞ oṃ wa ru ṇa ye gṛh+ṇa dam̐ nai wi te swāhā/ de bzhin du/ oṃ a nan+da༞ oṃ ba su ka ye༞ oṃ tak+ṣa ka ye༞ oṃ karko ṭa ye༞ oṃ pad+ma ye༞ oṃ mahā pad+ma ye༞ oṃ sham̐ kha pā la ye༞ oṃ ku li ka ye༞ oṃ lwa ru ṇa ye gṛh+ṇa dam̐ shap+ta swāhā/ de bzhin du/ oṃ a nan+da༞ oṃ ba su ka ye༞ oṃ tak+ṣa ka ye༞ oṃ karko ṭa ye༞ oṃ pad+ma ye༞ oṃ mahā pad+ma ye༞ oṃ sham̐ kha pā la ye༞ oṃ ku li ka ye༞ 'di la shap+ta mi bya ba'i lugs kyang 'dug cing dpyad par bya'o/ /zhal zas kyi skabs/ 'bras chan 'o ma dang sbyar ba dang / snum khur/ mngar gsum sogs kyi kha zas bzang po sku gzugs re re la 'bul ba'am/ yang na gtor ma la bzhag par bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma la chu bran la/ bsang sbyangs byas la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas la/ oṃ wa ru ṇa ye/ a nan+da ye/ ba su ka ye/ tak+ṣa ka ye/ karko ṭa ye/ pad+ma ye/ mahā pad+ma ye/ sham̐ kha pā la ye/ ku li ka ye na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥ bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba na ga lai ra ti na phuḥ

ṭa ṭa ra tsi te he he gṛh+ṇe dam̐ ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ thun mong ma yin pa'i mchod pa ni/ oṃ wa ru ṇa ye gṛh+ṇe dam̐ pra tits+tsha i dam̐ tsha tram̐ ka swāhā/ de bzhin du/ oṃ a nan+da ye༞ oṃ ba su ka ye༞ oṃ tak+ṣa ka ye༞ oṃ karko ṭa ye༞ oṃ pad+ma ye༞ oṃ mahā pad+ma ye༞ oṃ sham̐ kha pā la ye༞ oṃ ku li ka ye gṛh+ṇe dam̐ pra tits+tsha i dam̐ tsha tram̐ ka swāhā/ zhes pa rnams kyis gdugs dmar po dang / yang de bzhin du/ oṃ wa ru ṇa ye gṛh+ṇe dam̐ pra tits+tsha i dam pa tram̐ ka swāhā/ de bzhin du/ oṃ a nan+da ye༞ oṃ ba su ka ye༞ oṃ tak+ṣa ka ye༞ oṃ karko ṭa ye༞ oṃ pad+ma ye༞ oṃ mahā pad+ma ye༞ oṃ sham̐ kha pā la ye༞ oṃ ku li ka ye༞ sogs kyis gdan dang / yang / oṃ wa ru ṇa ye gṛh+ṇe dam̐ pra tits+tsha i dam̐ ya dzño pa wi traṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du/ oṃ a nan+da ye༞ oṃ ba su ka ye༞ oṃ tak+ṣa ka ye༞ oṃ karko ṭa ye༞ oṃ pad+ma ye༞ oṃ mahā pad+ma ye༞ oṃ sham̐ kha pā la ye༞ oṃ ku li ka ye༞ zhes sogs kyis ras skud dmar po rnams 'bul lo/ /drug pa bstod pa ni/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ mtha' yas nor rgyas la sogs klu dbang rnams/ /chu gter rgya mtsho'i gting mtha' rab zab nas/ /rin chen sna tshogs kyis spras yid 'ong ba'i/ /pho brang 'byor ba che ldan gnas na bzhugs/ /dbu la gdengs ka'i nor bu tshogs dbus nas/ /yid bzhin nor bu bsam kun rdzogs byed cing / /bdag gzhan don 'byor phun tshogs 'byung ba'i gnas/ /'od 'bar la sogs mun sel rnams kyis brgyan/ /tshe rabs du mar yon tan legs sbyangs mthus/ /klu dbang 'byor pa mtha' yas yang dag rdzogs/ /rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs che la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab khyod la 'dud/ /dad ldan rgyal ba'i bka' thos zhal mthong zhing / /bsgrub la brtson pa sangs rgyas thugs su chud/ /thabs dang snying rjes gzhan don rdzogs mdzad pa/

/bdag dang gzhan don 'byor pa khyod la 'dud/ /sngon tshe bde gshegs spyan sngar bka' bsgos te/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro la phan gdags phyir/ /dam las mi 'da' dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /gsol gdab las mdzod bdag don yongs rdzogs mdzod/ /klu yi dpe kha cig la 'di'i 'phrin bcol 'di mi snang / rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pas bstod pa dang 'phrin las bcol lo/ /lnga pa gdon gyi bya ba la bzhi/ mchod pa/ gso ba/ dbang bskur ba/ dam la bzhag pa'o/ /dang po mchod pa'i yul spyan drang bar bya ste/ gdengs ka'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ nā ga nan/ nā ga ni nan/ nā ga ku ma ra nan/ nā ga ku ma ra ni nan/ a gats+tsha ya/ a gats+tsha ya/ lan gsum gyi klu phal ba rigs bzhi dang / yang / oṃ bhu mi pa ti nan/ bhu mi pa ti ni nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra ni nan/ a gats+tsha ya/ a gats+tsha ya/ zhes lan gsum gyis sa bdag phal pa rigs bzhi dgug de nas bye brag tu sha gnyer ba dgug ste/ sems can thams cad dang / bye brag tu sha gnyer ba rnams la snying brtse ba'i bsam pas/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgyas bcing la bden pa'i stobs brjod cing dgug ste/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas gyi༞

che ge mo/ zhes bya ba la gnod cing sha gnyer ba'i rigs thams cad/ oṃ bhu mi pa ti nan/ bhu mi pa ti ni nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra ni nan gṛh+ṇe dam̐ ar+gham̐ swāhā/ oṃ bhu mi pa ti nan/ bhu mi pa ti ni nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra ni nan gṛh+ṇe dam̐ pā dam̐ swāhā/ oṃ bhu mi pa ti nan/ bhu mi pa ti ni nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra ni nan gṛh+ṇe dam̐ puṣ+pe swāhā/ oṃ bhu mi pa ti nan/ bhu mi pa ti ni nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra ni nan gṛh+ṇe dam̐ dhu pe swāhā/ oṃ bhu mi pa ti nan/ bhu mi pa ti ni nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra ni nan gṛh+ṇe dam̐ di pam̐ swāhā/ oṃ bhu mi pa ti nan/ bhu mi pa ti ni nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra ni nan gṛh+ṇe dam̐ gan+dham̐ swāhā/ oṃ bhu mi pa ti nan/ bhu mi pa ti ni nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra ni nan gṛh+ṇe dam̐ nai wi te swāhā/ oṃ bhu mi pa ti nan/ bhu mi pa ti ni nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra ni nan gṛh+ṇe dam̐ shap+ta swāhā/ oṃ bhu mi pa ti nan/ bhu mi pa ti ni nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra ni nan gṛh+ṇe dam̐ tsha tram̐ ka swāhā/ oṃ bhu mi pa ti nan/ bhu mi pa ti ni nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra ni nan gṛh+ṇe dam̐ pa tam̐ ka swāhā/ oṃ bhu mi pa ti nan/ bhu mi pa ni ni nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra ni nan gṛh+ṇe dam̐ yad dzño pa wi tram̐ swāhā/ zhes sogs kyis mchod/ gtor ma chus bran la/ bsang sbyangs byin rlabs sngar bzhin dang / phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ nā ga nan/ nā ga ni nan/ nā ga ku ma ra nan/ nā ga ku ma ra ni nan/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ

sarba na ga le ra ti na phuḥ ṭa ṭa ra tsi te he he gṛh+ṇe dam̐ ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/ zhes pas klu phal pa dang / oṃ nā ga nan/ nā ga ni nan/ nā ga ku ma ra nan/ nā ga ku ma ra ni nan/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba na ga le ra ti na phuḥ ṭa ṭa ra tsi te he he gṛh+ṇe dam̐ ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/ zhes pas klu sha gnyer ba rnams dang / oṃ bhu mi pa ti nan/ bhu mi pa ti ni nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra ni nan/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba na ga le ra ti na phuḥ ṭa ṭa ra tsi te he he gṛh+ṇa dam̐ ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/ zhes pas sa bdag phal pa dang / oṃ bhu mi pa ti nan/ bhu mi pa ti ni nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra nan/ bhu ma pa ti ka ma ra ni nan/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba na ga lai ra ti na phuḥ ṭa ṭa ra tsi te he he gṛh+ṇa dam̐ ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/ zhes pas sa bdag sha gnyer ba sogs la lan gsum gyis phul/ de nas klu'i dam tshig bskul ba'i phyir gdengs ka'i phyag rgya bcings la/ oṃ bhu shwa ra bh+yoḥ nā ge bh+yoḥn maḥ.oṃ pra shwa re bh+yoḥnā ge bh+yaḥnā maḥ.oṃ bhur+bhu wa swa sha re bh+yoḥnā ge bh+yoḥn maḥ.oṃ mahā nā ga ya bid ma he nā ga ru pa ya ti/ ma he dan+to/ nā ga pra bhe ta ye swāhā/ lan gsum dang / oṃ bhu shwa re bh+yoḥ bhu mi pa ti bh+yoḥ na maḥ.oṃ pra shwa re bh+yoḥ bhu mi pa ti bh+yoḥnā maḥ oṃ bhur+bhu wa swā sha re bh+yoḥ bhu mi pa ti bh+yoḥ na maḥ oṃ mahā bhu mi pa ti ya/ bid ma he bhu mi pa ti ru pa ya ti/ ma he dan+to/ bhi mi pa ti pra bhe ta ye swāhā/ lan gsum gyis sa bdag gi dam tshig bskul lo/ /de ni klu dang sa bdag mchod pa'i cho ga'o/ /bsnad pa med na de tsam gyis chog pas/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i rjes chog rnams bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de rnams bsnad cing nyams par gyur na/ mi dag na bar 'gyur te/

de dag gi nad ma gsos na mi'i nad mi gsos pas/ nad pa khrus byas pa'i chu klung dang sa bdag phal ba'i gzugs brnyan gyi steng du blug ste/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas༞ chos kyi༞ dge 'dun gyi༞ 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i༞ phyogs skyong bcu'i༞ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs dang / bdag cag gi bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang / bden pa de'i mthus sbyin pa'i bdag po che ge mo/ la gnod cing sha gnyer ba'i klu dang sa bdag gi rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad zhi ba'i sems dang ldan par gyur nas/ skad cig thang cig yud tsam la sa'i gnas 'dir mchis par gyur cig nā ga ar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes lan gsum brjod cing sems kyis/ rang gi snying kha'i hriḥlas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ thabs dang / mi gtsang ba dang / sa brkos pa dang / me btang ba dang / khang khyim la sogs pa brtsigs pas de dag bsnad cing nyams pa dang / nad kyis thebs pa dang / skye ba snga ma'i sha 'khon las 'dir gnod pa srid pas/ de dag gi nad ma gsos na/ mi'i nad mi sos pas bsnad cing nyams pa'i klu dang sa bdag rnams bkug ste gzugs brnyan la thim/ zhes brjod cing bstims/ de nas rtsi sman gyi bum pa nas gzugs brnyan la ku shas gtor cing / oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dha lo tsa ne sarba ar+tha sā dha na ye swāhā/ oṃ pra bha wa dh+ya bhu pra bha wa dh+ya bhur+bhu wa swa pra bha wa dh+ya/ sa bid pra/ pra wa dh+ya/ sarba nā ga duḥ kho pra sha ma na ye swāhā/ zhes yum gnyis kyi sngags dang / oṃ di bya a mṛ te san+tarapa sha mi te/ pra tits+tsha/ tha pa pa nan na ma swāhā/ zhes pa bdud rtsir bsgyur ba'i sngags dang bcas pa brjod/ gsum pa ni/ sdug bsngal gsos kyang phyir ldog pa srid pas/ phyir mi ldog par bya ba'i phyir dbang bskur te/

klu'i bum pa nas ku shas gtor zhing klu dang sa bdag gi gzugs brnyan la blug cing gtor bar bsam la/ oṃ āḥhriḥsingha na da hūm̐ phaṭ/ seng ge sgra'i snying po'o/ /oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha/ sid+dhi lo tsā ne sarba ar+tha sā dha na ye swāhā/ oṃ pra bha wa dh+ya bhu pra bha wa dh+ya bhur+bhu wa swa pra bha wa dh+ya/ sa bid tra/ pra wa dh+ya sarba nā ga duḥ kho pra sha ma na ye swāhā/ yum gyi sngags so/ /oṃ phuḥwa ru ṇa ye nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ phuḥ.a nan+da ya nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ phuḥb su ka ye nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ phuḥtak+ṣa ka ya nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ phuḥkarko ṭa ye nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ phuḥpad+ma ye nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ phuḥmahā pad+ma ye nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ phuḥshaṃ kha pā la ye nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ phuḥku li ka ye nā ga ra dzaḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ klu rgyal dgu'i sngags so/ /oṃ sha ta sa ha shra ak+ṣi ye/ ag+ni ye/ ya ma ye/ ni ri ti ye/ wa ru ṇa ye/ wa ya we ye/ ku be ra ye/ ru ṭa ye/ ur+dhi bra ha ma na ye/ sur+ya gra ha a dhi pa ta ye/ tsiṇ+ḍa nak+ṣa a dhi pa ta ye/ a dhi pra thi bh+yaḥ a su re bh+yaḥ nā ge bh+yaḥswāhā/ phyogs skyong bcu gnyis kyi sngags so/ /de rnams kyi mthar/ sarba nā ga duḥkho pra sha ma na ye a bhi ṣiñtsa mam̐ zhes dang / sarba bhu mi pa ti duḥ kho pra sha ma na ye a bhi ṣiñtsa mam̐/ zhes pas dbang bskur ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ g.yas rdo rje gsor zhing bden pa brdar te dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bsngags/ /dam tshig 'di las 'das na ni/ /myur du rigs rnams brlag par 'gyur/ /oṃ āḥhriḥsingha nā da hūm̐ phaṭ/ sarba nā ga sa mā ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces dang / sarba bhu mi pa ti sa mā ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/

zhes pas dam la bzhag go /drug pa bsgrub bya la ji ltar bya ba la/ bkru ba dang / byab pa dang / bsrung ba dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sbyin bdag sogs mdun duganas pa la slob dpon gyis/ bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chus khyed rang gi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nad gdon/ khyad par klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad bum pa'i chus bkrus te sangs kyis sdig sgrib sogs dag par mos pa mdzod/ lha'i bum pas/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ /thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med/ /byin rlabs ye shes chu yis ni/ /ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shrī hūm̐/ zhes brjod la khrus bya'o/ /de nas/ gang la ser sna rnams chags pa/ /rnam bcom dri ma med mdzad cing / /thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams/ /thar pa'i lam du 'jug mdzad cing / /chos rnams thams cad ston pa des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /gang la bde ba mnga' mdzad des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /skyobs pa gang zhig byams pa yi/ /thugs kyis 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /zhes brjod pa'i rjes la/ oṃ āḥhriḥsingha nā da hūm̐ phaṭ sbyin pa'i bdag po che ge mo'i/ nad thams cad sarba nā ga nan/ nā ga ni nan/ nā ga ku ma ra nan/ nā ga ku ma ra ni nan/ sarba pā pam̐ bh+yaḥshan+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ sarba bi ghā nan༞ sarba ro ga༞ sarba duṣ+ṭan༞ sarba gra he༞ sarba dz+wa re༞ sarba byā dhi༞ sarba u pa dra we༞ sarba a ka la m-i tayu༞ sarba dur swab ni༞ sarba durmi te༞ sarba tsit+ta ku le bh+yaḥshin+taṃ ku ru swāhā/ de bzhin du yum gnyis la'ang / oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsā ne sarba ar+tha swa dha na ye swāhā/

oṃ phuḥpad+ma ye nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ phuḥmahā pad+ma ye nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ phuḥsham̐ kha pā la nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ phuḥku li ka ye nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ sbyin pa'i bdag po che ge mo'i/ nad thams cad sarba bhu mi pa ti nan/ bhu ma pa ti ni nan/ bhi mi pa ti ku ma ra nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ri ni nan/ sarba pā pam̐ bh+yaḥrak+ṣa rak+ṣa swāhā/ sarba bi ghā nan/ sarba ro ga nan༞ ya ma ye༞ sarba duṣ+ṭan༞ sarba gra he༞ sarba dz+wa re༞ sarba byā dhi༞ sarba u pa dra we༞ sarba a ka la mṛ t+yu༞ sarba dur swab ni༞ sarba durmi te༞ sarba tsit+ta ku le bh+yaḥ oṃ sha ta sa ha shra ak+ṣe ye༞ ag+ne ye༞ ya ma ye/ ni ri ti ye༞ wa ru ṇa ye༞ wa ya we ye༞ ku be ra ya༞ ru ṭa ye༞ ur+dham̐ bra ha ma na ye༞ sur+ya gra ha a dhi pa ta ye/ tsaṇ+ḍa nak+ṣa a dhi pa ta ye/ a dhi pra thi bh+yaḥ a su re bh+yaḥ nā ge bh+yaḥswāhā/ sbyin pa'i bdag po che ge mo'i/ nad thams cad sarba bhu mi pa ti nan/ bhu ma pa ti ni nan/ bhi mi pa ti ku ma ra nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra ni nan/ sarba pā pam̐ bh+yaḥ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swāhā/ sarba bi ghā nan༞ sarba ro ga༞ sarba duṣ+ṭan༞ sarba gra he༞ sarba dz+wa re༞ sarba byā dhi༞ sarba u pa dra we༞ sarba a ka la mṛ t+yu༞ sarba dur swab ni༞ sarba durmi te༞ sarba tsit+ta ku le bh+yaḥ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swāhā/ sogs kyis sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad bsrung ngo / /de nas/ slob dpon phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu bkra shis kyis mnga' gsol bar mos pa mdzod/ me tog gtor rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang / /lha rnams kun gyi bsam pa yis/ /khyed kyi 'dod don gang yin pa/ /don de de ring 'grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs 'gyur/ /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs 'gyur/ /khyed cag lam 'gro bde gyur cig

/nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing / /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /ces brjod nas bsgrub bya gos rnying pa spangs te/ gsar pa bskon nas/ thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du rdo rje 'dzin du bcug la/ sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal/ /chos ni chos ma yin las rgyal/ /dge 'dun mu stegs pa las rgyal/ /lha dbang lha min dag las rgyal/ /zla ba sgra gcan dag las rgyal/ /nam mkha' lding ni klu las rgyal/ /me ni shing rnams kun las rgyal/ /chu ni me las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /rlung ni sprin rnams kun las rgyal/ /rdo rje yis ni rin chen phug /lha rnams bden par rab tu gnas/ /sa yang bden par gnas pa lags/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun bden/ /bden par rgyal gyur rdzun ma mchis/ /na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi༞ chos kyi༞ dge 'dun gyi༞ 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i༞ klu'i rgyal po dgu'i༞ phyogs skyong bcu'i༞ bde ba chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis/ che ge mo/ 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad kyi rigs su gyur pa rlung las gyur pa dang / mkhris pa las gyur pa dang / bad kan las gyur pa dang / 'dus pa las gyur pa dang / nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi nye bar zhi bar gyur cig gdon gyi rigs su gyur pa steng lha'i gdon dang / 'og klu'i gdon/ bar mi ma yin gyi gdon la sogs pa gdon stong phrag brgyad cu'i gnod pa thams cad med par gyur cig tshe dang dpal dang 'byor pa dang / dbang phyug dang grags pa la sogs pa'i bde legs thams cad zla ba yar ngo ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas pa'i phyin rlabs dang / /gsang sngags rigs sngags rnams kyi mthu stobs kyis/ /'gro ba 'di dag bdag gis bsrungs zin gyis/ /'di la sus kyang gnod pa ma byed cig

/lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba dang / /tshe ring nad med longs spyod 'phel ba dang / /theg pa mchog la nges par 'byung ba yis/ /bkra shis des kyang ding 'dir bde legs shog /sbyin pa'i bdag po che ge mo 'khor dang bcas pa nyi ma dang zla ba sgra gcan las grol ba bzhin du klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad las thar zhing / mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal bar gyur cig dza ya dza ya bi ya/ zhes brjod nas/ langs te khri la sogs pa'i steng du bzhag go /nad pa la dkar gsum la sogs pa'i zas bzang po sman du bsam la drangs te/ sangs rgyas mngon par sangs rgyas tshe/ /'jig rten skyong bzhis phyogs bzhi nas/ /snod bzhi dag ni blangs nas kyang / /bde bar gshegs la phul ba dang / /mthu yis gcig tu sprul mdzad nas/ /lha yi snod mchod de dag tu/ /bdud rtsi 'dra ba'i sman rnams ni/ /ston pa'i phyag na bsnams pa yi/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis/ /sa bdag klu gnyan nad sel zhing / /nyes pa de dag 'dren byed pa'i/ /sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog /de bzhin lha mo 'phrog ma yis/ /lha rdzas dge ba a ru ra/ /blangs nas ston la rab phul ba/ /bdag nyid 'dra ba'i sman rnams ni/ /ston pa'i phyag na bsnams pa yi/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis/ /sa bdag klu gnyan nad sel zhing / /nyes pa thams cad 'phrog byed pa/ /sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog /sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gzi brjid dang / /gtsug tor can gyi stobs mchog dang / /thams cad skyobs kyi bden tshig dang / /log dad sel gyi ting 'dzin dang / /gser thub ces bya'i ye shes dang / /'od srung gi ni rdzu 'phrul dang / /shākya seng ge'i mthu stobs dang / /seng ge sgra yi smon lam gyi/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis/ /sa bdag klu gnyan nad sel zhing / /nyes pa thams cad 'phrog byed pa'i/ /sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog

/sad+ya the danakha re kha re wa wa re/ tsa le bi tsa le/ bhi lam̐ bhi ma le/ pa ma pa ti/ tsaṇ+ḍe tsaṇ+ḍe ṇi/ a mṛ te/ nar+gho she swāhā/ de nas/ oṃ āḥhrīḥsingha na da hūm̐ phaṭ/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas me tog gtor zhing / che ba'i che mchog ston mchog bla na med/ /chos rje nyi ma rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bdud dang bgegs rigs gnod pa'i dgra zhi ste/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /chos nyid bden pa'i chos mchog bla na med/ /dam chos bdud rtsi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal gdung ba'i dgra zhi ste/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /dge 'dun yon tan rin chen dpal 'bar ba/ /rgyal sras phan mdzad bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral dge tshogs rnam par 'phel/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /tshangs dang lha dbang srung ma'i byin rlabs dang / /phan mdzad lha yi bkra shis gnas gyur te/ /dge legs bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan par shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing / /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs shing / /dkon mchog gsum gyis deng 'dir bde legs shog /ces pas bkra shis brjod/ zas la longs spyod pa'i lhag ma sa bdag gi gzugs 'gros kyi steng du bzhag go /zhes pa 'di phyag len ltar bris pa yin zhing / mdzad mi spro na/ sngar bshad pa'i/ sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal/ /zhes sogs kyi tshig bcad zas sman du bsgyur ba'i bar rnams la brjod kyang nyes pa med cing / rje thams cad mkhyen pa bud+dha'i mtshan de ltar mdzad do/ /yang nad pa sogs med na bkru byab bsrung gsum sogs bya mi dgos pas rjes kyi cho ga byas pas chog go /gsum pa rjes la lnga/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa/ bzod par gsol ba/ gshegs su gsol ba/ bdag nyid bsrung ba/ dge ba bsngo ba'o/

/dang po ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭ/ kyis bsang / oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dhoḥham̐/ zhes pas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ ces dang / so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+gham̐ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yam̐ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nas/ shap+ta'i bar byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta singha nā da sa pa ri wa ra ar+gham̐ pra tits+tsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta singha nā da sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yam̐ pra tits+tsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes sogs thog mtha' gnyis 'dra ba las pā d+yaṃ gyi gnas su/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ di pam̐/ gan+dham̐/ nai wi te/ shap+ta/ rnams bcug la so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas shing / rol mo dang bcas/ dharma ra ṇi/ brjod pas mchod la/ brtse ba'i thugs rje dbang phyug nyid kyi sku/ /drang srong chen po'i tshul du bzhugs nas kyang / /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal drag po sel mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni/ /sa 'og mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa/ /bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs pa/ /chos kyi dbyings las dbyer med kyang / /rnam 'phrul du mas bstan pa skyong / /phyogs skyong bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ sa bdag klu gnyan gyi gnod pa thams cad zhi ba dang /

rje btsun seng ge sgra'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ gnyis pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra sa twa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ ḍi ḍadho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+tam̐ shrī yam̐ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wan sarba ta thā ga ta/ badz+ra mā me muñtsa/ badz+ri bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ zhes pa'i yi ge brgya ba tshar gsum dang / ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol/ /sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol lo/ /gsum pa ni/ mchod pa yas nas mchod/ gshegs pa mas nas gshegs pas/ gdengs ka'i phyag rgya bkrol la/ oṃ chen nam chung ngu gang dag gi /lus la mngon par gnod gyur pa'i/ /nad de nye bar phyung nas su/ /klu rnams rang gi gnas su dengs/ /de ltar bdag gis ci nus kyis/ /mchod dang bsnyen bkur byas pa yi/ /dam tshig gnas la gnas kyis la/ /bdag gi bsam pa bskang bar mdzod/ /rtag tu dam tshig la gnas shing / /'dir ni sbyin pa'i bdag po yi/ /nad de rab tu bsrung mdzod la/ /klu rnams rang gi gnas su song / /nā ga nan/ nā ga ni nan/ nā ga ku ma ra nan/ nā ga ku ma ra ni nan/ a hi gats+tsha/ zhes pas klu phal pa'i rigs dang / yang / bhu mi pa ti nan/ bhu mi pa ti ni nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra nan/ bhu mi pa ti ku ma ra ni nan/ a hi gats+tsha/ zhes pas sa bdag phal pa bzhi dang / yang / oṃ wa ru ṇa ye/ a nan+da ye/ ba su ka ye/ tak+ṣa ka ye/ karko ṭa ye/ pad+ma ye/ mahā pad+ma ye/ sham̐ kha pā la ye/ ku li ka ye/ a hi gats+tsha/ zhes pas klu chen dgu gshegs su gsol ba dang / yang / oṃ sha ta sa ha shra ak+ṣi ye/ ag+ne ye/ ya ma ye/ ni ri ti ye/ wa ru ṇa ye/ wa ya we ye/ ku be ra ye/ ru ṭa ye/ ur+dham̐ bra ha ma na ye/

sur+ya gra ha a dhi pa ta ye/ tsaṇ+ḍa nak+ṣa a dhi pa ta ye/ a dhi pri thi bh+yaḥ a su re bh+yaḥ na ge bh+yaḥswāhā/ a hi gats+tsha/ zhes pas mtheb srin gyi se gol dang bcas pas gshegs su gsol/ rgyas par na/ nā ga nan a hi gats+tsha zhes pas sngags so so'i mthar a hi gats+tsha btags pas gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥ rdul tshon gyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs dam tshig pa rnams rang la gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ āḥhriḥsingha nā da hūm̐ phaṭ/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes brjod la lag pa g.yon gyi mtheb srin gyis lha'i mtshan ma nas blangs la bdag dang bsrung bya'i spyi bor bzhag rdul tshon so so rang gi dkyil 'khor dang / lha'i rdul tshon klu'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bzhag pa rnams mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len las shes par bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ nad pa'i gdon rang la phog srid pas/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying khar hūm̐ sngon po/ rnams kyis byin gyis brlab cing / bsrung ba'i bye brag gzhan yang bya'o/ /lnga pa ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'jig rten dbang phyug 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces brjod cing dge ba bsngos la/ de nas thog mar dar/ dung / rnga / sil snyan/ spos sna sogs bya zhing / slob dpon seng ge sgra'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas snying po zlos bzhin pas/ lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur ba'i bum pa'i chu bsgreng zhing / g.yon dril bu rgyun chags su dkrol zhing 'gro ba'i rjes su/ klu phal pa'i gzugs 'gros dang de'i gtor ma/ de'i rjes su klu'i gzugs dang / klu dang rtsi sman gyi bum pa/

gtor ma phyogs skyong dang 'byung po'i gtor ma/ lha'i gtor ma la sogs pa rnams dge slong ngam/ rab byung / ma 'byor na khye'u gtsang mas khyer nas 'gro la/ yang gong gi rol mo rnams ma 'byor na slob dpon gyis dril bu sil bas kyang chog par mdzad do/ /gong gi gzugs 'gros gtor ma sogs klu gnas pa'i mtsho'am chu mig gam/ 'bab chu la sogs pa'i gnas su bskyal lo/ /chur skyel sa med tshe/ sa la dong brus pa'i nang du bcug la kha g.yam pa la sogs pas bcad de bya khyis mi bza' bar bya'o/ /chu bor bskyal ba'i chu de nas dbang bskur ba'i bum par chu khyer la slob dpon gyis rting mnan nas rak+ṣa brjod cing nang du log nas thig rjes rnams dbyi'o/ /slob dpon 'khor bcas kyis bla ma yi dam chos skyong nor lha sogs kyi bkra shis rgyas par bya zhing me tog gi char dbab bo/ /'khor gsum mi rtog pa'i ngang nas dge ba sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo zhing rjes kyi bya ba mi mngon par byas la dga' don longs spyad cing slob dpon 'khor bcas yon gyis mnyes par bya'o/ /yang zhag sbrel nas byed na/ phyogs skyong gshegs gsol yan gong ltar byas rjes/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang / /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ /sogs kyis brtan bzhugs byas la/ gnas gsum bsrung ba/ dge ba bsngo ba sogs gong bzhin bya/ de 'phral sngar ltar gzugs 'gros sogs bskyel/ yang sang nyin gyi grab kyi gzugs yang bla ma gong ma 'ga' re/ phyag len 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir zhag tu byed kyang gzugs 'gros kyang sngar bsham pa de khas chog par mdzad pas 'gal ba med pa yin nam snyam mo/ /gzugs 'gros rnams bcos bum pa rnams kha gso sogs nyin re bzhin bya/ nub tha ma la dkyil 'khor gshegs gsol la sogs pa sngar ltar bya ba ste/ zhib tu mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len las shes par bya ba ste/

gdon sgrol gyi cho ga lag len dang bcas pa gsal bar bshad pa'i yi ge phun tshogs bsam 'phel zhes bya ba bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ sa skya'i rje btsun las 'ongs man ngag mchog /phan yon gzhal du med pa dang ldan pa'i/ /gdon sgrol cho ga'i lag len 'di bkod pa'i/ /dge bas bdag gzhan sgrib kun byang gyur cig /'dir 'bad bsod nams kyis mtshon legs bshad mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob brgyud par bcas pa yis/ /bod yul chol kha gsum sogs 'dzam gling gi /skye 'gro lha mi thams cad dbang 'dus shog /sngon tshe chos rje khu dbon ci 'dra ba'i/ /'phrin las de 'drar gyur nas gangs ljongs 'di'i/ /'gro kun sa skya'i rje btsun bzhed gzhung gi /rjes zhugs de rgyun srid mthar nyams med shog /de la brten nas sngags 'chang yab sras kyi/ /rjes 'brang bstan 'dzin skyes bu bgrang yas pa/ /kha ba ri pa'i yul gru kun khyab ste/ /kun kyang rdzogs ldan bde la spyod par shog /bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyang tshe mthar phyin/ /bsam don lhun grub bstan pa cher rgyas shing / /phyi ma lhan cig bde ba can skyes nas/ /gang 'dul sprul pas 'gro ba'i don byed shog /ces gdon sgrol gyi cho ga'i lag len shin tu gsal bar bshad pa'i yi ge phun tshogs bsam 'phel zhes bya ba 'di yang snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi thugs sras dam pa gcen grub mchog bsod nams dbang po dang / gcung yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas grags pa blo gros te rigs ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched zhal rnam pa gnyis dang / rgyal ba kun gyi rigs bdag drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' dang gnyis su ma mchis pa rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams gtso bor smos pa'i yongs 'dzin bslu med kyi bla ma du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bo'i rgyan du bkod pa'i skal ba bzang po can sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/

gdan sa chen po'i brgya tsho dpon gyi bla ma chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis bskul zhing yi ge'i bya ba yang thor bur bgyis pa'i rkyen byas te/ lugs 'di la dgos pa'i yig cha/ sgrub thabs slob dpon tsan+t+ra go mis mdzad pa dang / gdon sgrol shrī ri ku ma ra se nas mdzad pa gnyis la brten pa'i phyag len mal lo tsā ba nas rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams la bka' bab cing thugs nyams su bzhes te/ yig cha mdzad pa yang / sa chen gyi nye gnas gnyan phul chung ba bsod nams rdo rjes gdon sgrol gyi cho ga rkyang pa dang / rje btsun rtse mos gdon sgrol ma gtogs gzhan rnams kyi yi ge zhib pa dang / gdon sgrol yang sa bcad tsam mdzad cing rje btsun chen po'i dngos slob dkar shākya grags dang / nub pa rig 'dzin grags gnyis kyis kyang shin tu zhib pa'i yi ge mdzad cing / chos rje sa skya paṇa chen gyis hor gyi rgyal po go dan gyi don du 'di'i cho ga rgyas par mdzad pa'i phyag len rgyun ma nyams pa/ chos rgyal 'phags pas ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin zin bris kyi tshul du chos rje rin chen rgyal mtshan pas bkod pa'i yi ge rgyas pa/ gzhan yang dmar chos kyi rgyal po/ sde snod 'dzin pa bsam 'grub bzang po/ chos rje srad pa kun dga' blo gros sogs kyis mdzad pa'i gsung rab de rnams la brten zhing / lhag par ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi dngos slob chos rje bsam 'grub bzang pos mdzad pa'i yig cha la/ bdag cag gi yongs 'dzin dam pa rje btsun 'khrul ba'i dri ma ma lus pa zad par spangs pa rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan de nyid kyis phyag len gyi rim pa ji ltar mdzad pa rnams sgra ji bzhin du gsal byed mchan bu'i brjed byang zhib tu btab pa'i yig cha khyad par can de nyid la gtso bor gzhi byas/ cung zad mi gsal ba sogs kha skong dgos pa rnams gong gi gsung rab de dag dang /
